_about: The shipped defaults for instincts.json: the documented fallback for any bad or missing value there. Keep the two equal (scripts/test_learning_config.py checks). This is how instincts.py learns, not what it learned: the lessons themselves are private and live in the vault (Denisse/Brain/instincts.json).

keywords._about: How a message becomes the keywords that link a failed request to its fix. word_pattern finds the words (in lower case); words shorter than min_chars or in stop_words are dropped; a lesson records at most when_max of them.

phrase_fillers._about: Polite words and her name, dropped when a lesson matches the original phrase.

results._about: Tool results that are no evidence a fix worked. refused_prefix: a call the brain blocked before running (evidence neither way). empty: no output at all. declined_prefixes / declined_contains: the tool ran but did nothing (contains is case-insensitive).

activation._about: A confirmed lesson needs at least this many positive episodes per observed negative one (4 = at least 80% positive feedback). How many confirmations it needs is learning_confirmations in memory/brain_rules.json.

store._about: evidence_ids_max: positive and negative evidence IDs kept per lesson. evidence_chars: how much of the failed and fixing message a lesson quotes. lock_tries x lock_retry_s: how long a rebuild waits for the store lock.

wording._about: The generated instincts.md in the vault. intro may use {confirmations}.
wording.description: What Denisse learned from being corrected - which tool to reach for. Generated after saved turns and nightly; edit instincts.json, not this.
wording.title: # Instincts
wording.intro:
Learned from turns Chuen corrected where the retry worked. They only change
**which tools she's offered** for a matching message -- nothing here enters her
prompt. Lessons activate after {confirmations} positively confirmed episodes.
They prioritise tools; they never grant new machine-changing permissions or remove existing tools. To switch one off, set
`"enabled": false` in `instincts.json` (a rebuild keeps it). See [[Self-Learning]].
